definitionZh: 文本导向 CSS 属性将文本字符的方向设置在一行中. 它只在垂直模式下影响文字(当写-mode不是水平-tb时). 用于控制使用垂直脚本的语言的显示,也用于制作垂直的表头.
sourceDefinition: The text-orientation CSS property sets the orientation of the text characters in a line. It only affects text in vertical mode (when writing-mode is not horizontal-tb). It is useful for controlling the display of languages that use vertical script, and also for making vertical table headers.
